title: Reschedule bookings
keywordPlaceholder: Enter code, name or phone number
rule: Bookings can only move to a slot with the same price. The payment status stays unchanged.
pickTitle: Choose a new court and time
willNotify: The customer will be notified of the new slot after confirmation.
confirmSub: Please check the details before updating.
afterTitle: After you confirm, the system will:
after1: Update the booking and lock the new time slot.
after2: Release the previous slot; the court stays under maintenance.
after3: Notify the customer and record the change history.
doneSub: The replacement slot has been saved.
successDesc: Booking {code} has been updated. The customer has been notified.
